## 2.24. Documenting the 30m Stop Distance and Brake Efficiency Failed Result for a Class 1 MOT Vehicle

In order to fully conform to the brake efficiency test requirements that are outlined in the _MOT Inspection Manual_, you will need to record the 30m Stop Distance and Brake Efficiency Failed Result. This must be recorded on the VT20 form with the assistance of the '30m stop distance' and 'brake efficiency failed' flags. If there is a failed test of both of these, the brake efficiency test will not pass.
